segments.text: here's how I became Brian Johnson's co-founder it started with an email when I was 21 I came across a quote from Brian that aligned with how I saw the future I'd found someone who had the same Ambitions so I messaged him every year for years LinkedIn email wherever I could reaching out applying pitching myself and I heard nothing back then years later I finally got an interview it was for an assistant role at the time I was managing million dooll budgets at the North Face but I knew this wasn't about title it was about a mission so I took a pay cut moved across the country

and got to work Brian was already deeply focused on his health when I pitched in the idea of making his journey a public science experiment sharing every detail with the world and that's when blueprint was born for the first year and a half no one noticed then one day the internet caught on and everything changed now Netflix is dropping a documentary January 1st follow over behind the scenes as we build this movement
